title: Sealing Room
description: Explains which hazards call for sealing a room and which don't, how to pick the room, and materials to keep on hand, including pre-cut plastic. Gives a three-step sealing procedure, warns about time limits and signs to unseal, and covers unsealing after the all-clear.
shortDescription: When sealing helps, which room to pick, and how long it's safe
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
